basic_profile.bio: I am a 45-year-old IT consultant living in Seattle. I've been a tech enthusiast ever since my college days and have a knack for Rocket League mods. When I'm not buried in work or tinkering with tech, I enjoy exploring local indie music scenes. I often browse Reddit late at night after work, especially on weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner of 10 years, and we're both pretty open-minded, hence my occasional visits to subreddits like AskRedditAfterDark. I dislike the superficiality often found in social media but appreciate meaningful conversations and genuine interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I've spent over two decades in the IT industry. My expertise lies in software development and cybersecurity, and I am self-taught in various gaming mod communities.
